events.did: 把枪收回枪套，改拔出一把刀
events.quote_anchor: He holstered his gun, and instead drew a knife.

events.did: 通过 Victor 腰带上的对讲机报出自己的名字，说 Victor 可以叫他 Gabriel
events.quote_anchor: “My name is Dr. Gray,” said the voice. “But you may call me Gabriel.”

events.did: 注意到特工背心正面的小黑珠是摄像头，并想起自己在汽车旅馆捏碎过一个
events.quote_anchor: He noted the small black beads on the front on the agents’ vests. Cameras. He’d crushed one, back at the motel.

events.did: 抓住最近一名特工的头盔借其冲势近身，把刀从头盔下缘向上刺入
events.quote_anchor: He grabbed the nearest agent by the helmet, using their own momentum to carry them in, and drove his blade up beneath the helmet’s chin.

events.did: 关掉自己的神经以承受电击，夺下电击棍并把刀插进特工护甲的缝隙
events.quote_anchor: He snapped his own nerves off, and caught the baton, twisting it out of the way as he sank the blade between the slats of the agent’s armor.

events.did: 抓住最后一名特工的头盔掰向一侧，折断其脖子
events.quote_anchor: when a pair of hands caught hold of the agent’s helmet and snapped it to the side, breaking their neck with an audible crack.

events.did: 摇头想否认，但世界仍在摇晃中停住，告诉 Mitch 他们已经抓走了她
events.quote_anchor: Victor started to shake his head, then stopped when the world kept rocking. “They already got her.”

events.did: 用掉最后一支吸入器药筒后弹出空药瓶，换上一支新的
events.quote_anchor: He ejected the spent vial, and slotted in a full one—his last—each task getting harder as the drug overwhelmed his system

relations.did: 与 EON 特工的关系：他说自己已把他们改造成适合对付 EO（如 Victor）的工具
relations.quote_anchor: “I’ve enabled them to serve a purpose. One that makes them uniquely suited to face EOs, like yourself.”

relations.did: 与 Victor 的关系：他表示期待与 Victor 见面
relations.quote_anchor: If it was possible for dead space to sound amused, it did. Then: “I look forward to meeting you, Victor.”

relations.did: 与 Dr. Gray 的关系：他怀疑对方是在 Stell 死后接管 EON 的人
relations.quote_anchor: “I assume you’re the one running the show now that Stell is gone.”

relations.did: 与 Director Stell 的关系：Stell 被发现死于自己手中的枪下，实际是 Victor 帮了他一把
relations.quote_anchor: But Victor had given him a little help.

numbers.who: 围攻 Victor 的 EON 特工人数
numbers.quote_anchor: as he waited to see which of the three agents would attack.
ignoring a dozen minor pains for the only one that mattered

numbers.who: 开枪射中 Victor 的特工
numbers.quote_anchor: as the last agent came toward him, gun raised to fire a second time

numbers.did: One second（前一秒）… the next（下一秒）
numbers.quote_anchor: One second you were heading toward her and the next—
